cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.author: Marta S.
cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.title: Warm without the itch
cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.body: Extra-fine merino means no forehead itch, which is all I ask. The double cuff sits exactly where it should and has not relaxed after a month.

cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.author: Oliver D.
cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.title: Lost the first, reordered
cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.body: Exactly as the description predicted. Same oat colour, zero regrets — at this price it is basically a consumable for winter.

cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.author: Chiara L.
cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.title: Seamless crown is the detail
cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.body: No ridge across the top, so it sits flat instead of pointing. Charcoal goes with every coat I own. Dried flat after a wash, unchanged.

cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.author: Ben A.
cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.title: Tested in actual weather
cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.body: Wore it through a week of sleet. Wind does not get through the rib and it dried overnight from damp. Buying the oat one next.

cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.author: Iris T.
cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.title: Gift that landed
cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.body: Gave two to my brother-in-law in the two colours. He texted a photo wearing one with everything from a parka to pyjamas. Package felt considered.

cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.author: Noah G.
cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.title: Quality merino, honest price
cmtohrrfa0007t4av5b5v6gz8.body: Compared it side by side with a designer beanie at triple the price — same rib density, same cuff. This is the one I reach for now.

cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.author: Hugo F.
cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.title: Patina after one month
cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.body: The chocolate has gone almost black where the buckle sits and warm everywhere else. Edges are burnished properly — no paint cracking like my old belts.

cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.author: Anna K.
cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.title: Bought two
cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.body: One for me, one for my father who has opinions about belts. His verdict: "finally, real brass." The Chicago screws mean the buckle can be swapped.

cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.author: Tom W.
cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.title: Size guide is accurate
cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.body: Ordered the 90 by the guide over trousers and it hits the third hole exactly. The strap has zero stretch after two months of daily wear.

cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.author: Sofia M.
cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.title: Feels like one object
cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.body: No glue line, no bonded layers — it flexes as one piece of leather. The brass has that soft yellow that suits both denim and suits.

cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.author: Jack H.
cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.title: The little things
cmtohrrf70006t4av8t3bxzxb.body: Hand-burnished edges you can feel with a thumb, and the keeper is stitched, not glued. Shipping box had a care card — nice touch, kept it.

cmtohrrf50005t4avlknags9a.author: Callum R.
cmtohrrf50005t4avlknags9a.title: Broke in within the week
cmtohrrf50005t4avlknags9a.body: Day one stiff, day four moulded to my foot, day seven I ordered a second pair in chocolate. The crepe sole makes cobblestones irrelevant.

cmtohrrf50005t4avlknags9a.author: Elena V.
cmtohrrf50005t4avlknags9a.title: Stitched, not glued
cmtohrrf50005t4avlknags9a.body: Checked the welt before buying because reviews are reviews — it is genuinely stitched. Suede is dense and even, no bald spots after two months.

cmtohrrf50005t4avlknags9a.author: Kenji M.
cmtohrrf50005t4avlknags9a.title: True to size, roomy toe
cmtohrrf50005t4avlknags9a.body: EU 42 fits my usual 42 with a thick sock. Sand colour goes with denim and tailoring alike. Water spray bead off the suede nicely after treating.

cmtohrrf50005t4avlknags9a.author: Lucy B.
cmtohrrf50005t4avlknags9a.title: Unisex done right
cmtohrrf50005t4avlknags9a.body: Ordered against my usual size guidance and the fit is clean on a narrower foot too. They look better scuffed than new, which is the point.

cmtohrrf20004t4avf0f7603l.author: Owen L.
cmtohrrf20004t4avf0f7603l.title: Carry-on legal, lifetime build
cmtohrrf20004t4avf0f7603l.body: Five flights in and the canvas is already picking up character while the brass stays bright. The strap is long enough for a proper crossbody carry.

cmtohrrf20004t4avf0f7603l.author: Maya D.
cmtohrrf20004t4avf0f7603l.title: Two days, no folding
cmtohrrf20004t4avf0f7603l.body: Fits a full change of clothes, trainers, washbag and a 14" laptop with room left. Stands up on its own even half-empty, which sounds small and is not.

cmtohrrf20004t4avf0f7603l.author: Ravi P.
cmtohrrf20004t4avf0f7603l.title: The handles will outlive me
cmtohrrf20004t4avf0f7603l.body: Bridle leather that was stiff for a week and now has a shine. My grandfather had a bag like this that he passed down — this feels like the same object.

cmtohrrf10003t4av6tuf2uby.author: Victor S.
cmtohrrf10003t4av6tuf2uby.title: Moves like a cardigan
cmtohrrf10003t4av6tuf2uby.body: The unstructured shoulder is exactly right — I can drive three hours in this. The herringbone reads charcoal across a room and warm up close.

cmtohrrf10003t4av6tuf2uby.author: Nadia A.
cmtohrrf10003t4av6tuf2uby.title: My husband lives in it
cmtohrrf10003t4av6tuf2uby.body: Wears it to the office with chinos and at weekends over a hoodie, somehow works both ways. Patch pockets keep the whole thing easy.

cmtohrrez0002t4avdqpvgt6f.author: Alessandro R.
cmtohrrez0002t4avdqpvgt6f.title: Smells like a proper outfitters
cmtohrrez0002t4avdqpvgt6f.body: The waxed cotton arrived with that deep beeswax smell and creases that mean business. Corduroy under-collar is the detail I did not know I needed.

cmtohrrez0002t4avdqpvgt6f.author: Grace H.
cmtohrrez0002t4avdqpvgt6f.title: Rain, tested
cmtohrrez0002t4avdqpvgt6f.body: Two weeks of Scottish drizzle and everything under it stayed dry. Re-waxed the shoulders once with the tin they recommend — took twenty minutes.

cmtohrrex0001t4avdlg5cybb.author: Jonah W.
cmtohrrex0001t4avdlg5cybb.title: Layering perfect
cmtohrrex0001t4avdlg5cybb.body: Over a heavy tee it is a jacket, under the waxed field jacket it disappears. The brushed face is soft but the check has stayed crisp after four washes.

cmtohrrex0001t4avdlg5cybb.author: Ines F.
cmtohrrex0001t4avdlg5cybb.title: Borrowed it and never gave it back
cmtohrrex0001t4avdlg5cybb.body: Bought it for my partner, wore it to the market, now ordering my own. The timber check photographs twice as expensive as it is.

cmtohrrex0001t4avdlg5cybb.author: Sam T.
cmtohrrex0001t4avdlg5cybb.title: Corozo buttons are a lovely touch
cmtohrrex0001t4avdlg5cybb.body: Little details everywhere — the pen slot in the pocket, the side gussets, buttons with actual grain. Fits true over a tee, snug over a knit.

cmtohrreu0000t4av0q5i1teq.author: Devan K.
cmtohrreu0000t4av0q5i1teq.title: The real thing
cmtohrreu0000t4av0q5i1teq.body: Own two high-street arans and this is another level — the cables are hand-linked and the wool still smells faintly of the mill. Heavy in the good way.

cmtohrreu0000t4av0q5i1teq.author: Tomas E.
cmtohrreu0000t4av0q5i1teq.title: Blocks back to shape
cmtohrreu0000t4av0q5i1teq.body: Wore it three weeks straight, washed it once by hand, dried flat — came back exactly to size. The oat colour goes with everything I own.

cmtohrreu0000t4av0q5i1teq.author: Priya N.
cmtohrreu0000t4av0q5i1teq.title: Bought one for my brother too
cmtohrreu0000t4av0q5i1teq.body: Gifted it in October and he has barely taken it off. The collar sits flat under a coat, which no other crewneck of ours manages.

cmtohrreu0000t4av0q5i1teq.author: Marco B.
cmtohrreu0000t4av0q5i1teq.title: Proper winter weight
cmtohrreu0000t4av0q5i1teq.body: Five-gauge is serious — warm enough on its own at 5°C with just a tee under. Sleeve length is generous, so size down if you are between.

cmtllo9vn0074ppfiy96thz0y.author: Amelia R.
cmtllo9vn0074ppfiy96thz0y.title: Exactly as promised
cmtllo9vn0074ppfiy96thz0y.body: Wore this three times in the first week. It layers well, washes well and gets compliments constantly. This is how clothing should be made.

cmtllo9vn0074ppfiy96thz0y.author: Isabella M.
cmtllo9vn0074ppfiy96thz0y.title: Happy overall
cmtllo9vn0074ppfiy96thz0y.body: Great quality and fast delivery. Only note is that the colour is slightly warmer than the photos, which I actually prefer. Would buy again.

cmtllo9vn0074ppfiy96thz0y.title: My new favourite piece
cmtllo9vn0074ppfiy96thz0y.body: I was sceptical about the price but the quality is genuinely there. The weight, the drape, the buttons — everything feels considered. Highly recommend.
